explanation: The theorem says a boundary point of a manifold with boundary has an open neighbourhood U homeomorphic to (U ∩ ∂M) × [0, ε), a local collar. I found nothing like it in Mathlib. Searching Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold for "collar" (case-insensitive) found only a comment in Bordism.lean that mentions the collar neighbourhood theorem. Searching for "Ico (0 : ℝ)" there found nothing. Searching all of Mathlib for a homeomorphism (≃ₜ) involving `boundary` also found nothing. The proof depends only on the library's own collar-chart machinery (`exists_isProductCollarChart_of_mem_boundary`, `homeomorphProd`, `EuclideanHalfSpace.homeomorphNormalIio`).
